DEPTH DIRECTION: the bed's lower edge (25535, 100) -> (25598, 72), slope dv/du -0.44 (it runs mostly east with a little depth; not a good receding edge). front/rear = ground under the crates' outer ends (est). Second pass, which reading: the barrow (kept). The two lattice crates are not hung level: the west crate (25530-25568, 75-98) stands lower and nearer, the east crate (25570-25600, 33-75) higher and further, one behind the other along a line that runs up to the east as a barrow's bed recedes here. A load on a shoulder pole would hang at one height on either side of its carrier, and the hooded man (25512-25555, v 28-75) is at the west end behind both crates, not between them. No wheel shows: it would be under the crates.

entities.name: round-topped cart (or stall under a round canopy) on the far street
entities.what: A large round-topped thing on a low frame on the far street: read as a parked cart under a round arched cover or carrying a huge round load, its bed (v 90-102) on props at u ≈ 25930 and 25990, its east end at the feeding horse. Faint.
entities.vis: faded
entities.note: Other reading: a stall table under a big round parasol (then a prop, not a vehicle). SCALE CUE: the round top u 25940-26005, v 30-92 (65 px wide, 62 tall); the bed u 25920-26037; props to v ≈ 132. No wheel is readable on the scan (the restyle paints a spoked wheel at u ≈ 26000-26020, v 85-112, and the load as a giant bale). front/rear = ground under the bed's ends (est). Second pass: the bed's two long horizontal members (v 100-113) run from u ~25912 to ~25998 and end there on legs at about u 25919 and 25987-25992 (feet v ~136-138). Between the bed's east end and the dark horse (body from u ~26030), close vertical posts stand at u 26000-26030 (v 65-134), and no shaft runs on to the horse. So front moved from (26035, 130 est) to (25998, 136 est), where the bed ends (the old front sat under the horse's hind feet at 26037). This does not settle cart or stall; it does weaken the horse's place in the cart's group: as drawn it is not in shafts. Either keep S2.grp.round_cart_26035 with a note, or leave the horse ungrouped.
